train_supervised_model: train a supervised fastText classification model from a labeled text file and return the model object
train_unsupervised_model: train an unsupervised fastText word vector model using skipgram or cbow on raw text data
load_fasttext_model: load a pre-trained fastText model from a file path and return a model object for inference
predict_labels_for_text: predict labels and probabilities for a single line of text using a trained supervised fastText model
get_word_vector: get the dense vector representation of a word from a trained fastText model
